law_record.title: Lamps on parked vehicle (3)
law_record.text: Whenever a vehicle is parked or stopped upon the traveled portion of a highway or shoulder adjacent thereto, whether attended or unattended during the times mentioned in NRS 484D.100 [NRS-484D-100-1], and there is insufficient light to reveal any person or object within a distance of 1,000 feet upon such highway or roadway, such vehicle shall display lighted lamps meeting the requirements of subsection 1 [(1) appended below]. Every vehicle shall be equipped with one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a white or amber light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the front of the vehicle, and one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a red light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the rear of the vehicle. The location of such lamps shall be such that at least one such lamp is installed as near as practicable to the side of the vehicle which is closest to passing traffic.

activation_conditions: the vehicle is parked or stopped on the travelled portion of a highway or the adjacent shoulder
the time is within the lighting section's hours
there is insufficient light to reveal a person or object at 1,000 feet
residue: the lamps' visibility distances (500 feet front and rear) are equipment properties, not observations of the scene; what a source sees is whether a lamp of that colour is lit and on which side
